{{Quote|I wish I could have floated in the seas of my home, one last time...|Ooroo|<ref name="TotJ" />}}
The [[Celegian/Legends|Celegian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]], who lived at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]&mdash;a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]&mdash;referred to a '''world''' with [[Water/Legends|seas]] on its surface as<ref name="TotJ" /> his<ref name="CSWE Ooroo">{{CSWECite|II|415|Ooroo}}</ref> home.<ref name="TotJ" /> Ooroo, who was born sometime prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="birthdate">According to the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comics]], [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]] was alive shortly before the end of the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]] of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]], which is dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. It can therefore be concluded that Ooroo was born sometime prior to this date.</ref> floated in those seas on several occasions during his life. During the Republic's [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|battle]] against invading Sith [[Army/Legends|armies]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kirrek]] in 5,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="date">The [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] is dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> Ooroo [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] his life in order to defeat the enemy, and, as he lay dying on the battlefield, the Celegian expressed to [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]], his [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]], his wish to float in the seas of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for a last [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="TotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ooroo's homeworld was first indirectly mentioned in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 4|fourth]] issue of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire|''The Fall of the Sith Empire'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published in [[1997]] and was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]]<ref name="TotJ" />
